sql.customFieldGroup.archiveRows: update flow.custom_field_group set archived = true where custom_field_id = :fieldId
sql.customFieldGroup.getOne: select cfgt.*, ot.object_type, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(customFields))) FROM ( SELECT cfg.id, cfg.custom_field_group_type_id as "customFieldGroupTypeId", cfg.custom_field_id as "customFieldId", cfg.ancillary_custom_field_group_id as "ancillaryCustomFieldGroupId", cfg.field_order as "fieldOrder", cfg.archived, cf.field_name as "fieldName" FROM flow.custom_field_group cfg inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfg.custom_field_id WHERE cfg.custom_field_group_type_id = cfgt.id AND cfg.archived is not true) customFields), '[]') AS "customFields" from flow.custom_field_group_type cfgt inner join flow.object_type ot on ot.id = cfgt.object_type_id where cfgt.id = :id
sql.customFieldGroup.getByObjectTypeId: select cfgt.*, cfgt.group_name as original_group_name, ot.object_type, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(customFields))) FROM ( SELECT cfg.id, cfg.custom_field_group_type_id as "customFieldGroupTypeId", cfg.custom_field_id as "customFieldId", cfg.ancillary_custom_field_group_id as "ancillaryCustomFieldGroupId", cfg.field_order as "fieldOrder", cfg.archived, cf.field_name as "fieldName" FROM flow.custom_field_group cfg inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfg.custom_field_id WHERE cfg.custom_field_group_type_id = cfgt.id AND cfg.archived is not true ORDER BY cfg.field_order) customFields), '[]') AS "customFields" from flow.custom_field_group_type cfgt inner join flow.object_type ot on ot.id = cfgt.object_type_id where ot.id = :objectTypeId and cfgt.archived is not true order by cfgt.group_order, cfgt.group_name
sql.customFieldGroup.getCustomFieldsInGroup: select cfg.*, cfgt.group_name, cf.field_name, cf.company_data_type_id, cf.date_created, cf.created_by_id, cf.modified_by_id, cf.date_modified from flow.custom_field_group cfg inner join flow.custom_field_group_type cfgt on cfgt.id = cfg.custom_field_group_type_id inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfg.custom_field_id where cfgt.id = :groupTypeId and cfg.archived is not true and cf.archived is not true order by cfg.field_order
sql.customFieldGroup.getAvailableCustomField: select cf.*, cfot.object_type_id from flow.custom_field_object_type cfot inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfot.custom_field_id where cfot.object_type_id = :objectTypeId and cfot.archived is not true and not exists (select custom_field_id from flow.custom_field_group cfg where cfg.custom_field_id = cf.id and cfg.custom_field_group_type_id = :groupTypeId and cfg.archived is not true) order by cf.field_name
sql.customFieldGroup.insertCustomFieldGroupT: insert into flow.custom_field_group_type(group_name, object_type_id, group_order, process_step_id) values (:groupName, :objectTypeId, :groupOrder, :processStepId);
sql.customFieldGroup.updateCustomFieldGroupT: update flow.custom_field_group_type set group_name = :groupName, group_order = :groupOrder where id = :id
sql.customFieldGroup.deleteCustomFieldGroupT: update flow.custom_field_group_type set archived = true where id = :id
sql.customFieldGroup.getCustomField: SELECT cfg.id, cfg.custom_field_group_type_id as "customFieldGroupTypeId", cfg.custom_field_id as "customFieldId", cfg.ancillary_custom_field_group_id as "ancillaryCustomFieldGroupId", cfg.field_order as "fieldOrder", cfg.archived, cf.field_name as "fieldName" FROM flow.custom_field_group cfg inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfg.custom_field_id WHERE cfg.id = :id
sql.customFieldGroup.addFieldToGroup: insert into flow.custom_field_group(custom_field_group_type_id, custom_field_id, ancillary_custom_field_group_id, field_order) values (:customFieldGroupTypeId, :customFieldId, :ancillaryCustomFieldGroupId, :fieldOrder)
sql.customFieldGroup.updateFieldInGroup: update flow.custom_field_group set field_order = :fieldOrder where id = :id
sql.customFieldGroup.deleteFieldFromGroup: update flow.custom_field_group set archived = true where id = :id
sql.customFieldGroup.deleteAllFieldsInGroup: update flow.custom_field_group set archived = true where custom_field_group_type_id = :id
